links.comparator_used: C0-only augmentation (original real texts only) versus C0+C1–C3 transformation-aware augmentation with ChatGPT-rewritten texts
links.outcome: Mean C1–C3 macro-F1 on unseen mitigation-test roots across nine detectors
links.effect: Monkeypox: +0.148 macro-F1 (9/9 models improved; Wilcoxon p=0.0039), C0 performance preserved (+0.004). FNIR: +0.035 (7/9 models improved; p=0.164). Cross-dataset transfer inconsistent.
links.tradeoff: Benefit was dataset-dependent: FNIR gains were small and heterogeneous, and the augmentation did not consistently generalise across datasets.
links.quote: Transformation-aware training increased mean C1–C3 macro-F1 on unseen Monkeypox roots by 0.148 across nine models (9/9 improved; Wilcoxon p=0.0039) while preserving panel-level C0 performance (+0.004).

design_hint: transformation-aware training augmentation and transformation-based stress testing
